title: Add the opt-in cached embedding step and the embedding proxy (S2)
description:
## Purpose

Add an opt-in, cached embedding step and the embedding row of the retrieval proxy (stop S2).

## Scope

An explicit `embed` script (never in specs; specs use the `fake` embedder) writing `var/embeddings.jsonl` keyed by provider, model, dimensions and text SHA-256; OpenAI `text-embedding-3-small`, 512 dims, for this public corpus. Then the same proxy with the in-memory embedding retriever.

## Cost cap

≈0.3M tokens ≈ $0.01 (verified price $0.02 / 1M tokens); one run, replays from cache.

## Definition of done (S2)

Embedding proxy row committed and reported; at most one D variant goes live, and only if the owner chooses one from the proxy table. Retrieval stays optional and off by default either way (Q3).

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §4.4, §5.2, §5.4, §6 step 6.
